decisions.reason: The XL package is a low-cost extension of the firm's established anamnesis app, was publicly announced as a first-time capability for large practices, and fits the announced paperless, digital direction, so management has every reason to persist with it.

The dedicated support service for dental assistants has its own web page, builds on the firm's core strength of responsive expert support, and any weak early uptake can be attributed to a normal ramp-up, so keeping it is the consistent choice.
